title: Playboy February 2007 Tricia Helfer Battlestar Galactica Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers bright with light handling wear; small scuff near the "Love Issue" text on the front. Spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, February 2007 - Special Love Issue. Original $5.99 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover: Battlestar Galactica's Tricia Helfer.

Cover features: Tricia Helfer sheds her Cylon suit; Simon Cowell interview; Bettie Page 20Q; Family Guy's Seth MacFarlane; designer Ozwald Boateng; cocktails, chemistry, corsets and the art of seduction.

Back cover: TNT 2007 NBA All-Star Game ad (Kobe Bryant, LeBron James, Shaquille O'Neal, Steve Nash).

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
